authority.rule: Code and live readback establish behavior. This record explains that behavior for humans and agents.

product.name: Full Time
product.oneSentence: Full Time turns one set of checked football facts into six complete shows, each made and performed by a different AI Pundit.
product.coreValue: The product is valuable because AI can create six genuinely different readings of the same match, while deterministic evidence controls keep the underlying facts honest.
product.primaryAudience: Football fans who want a playful, useful take on a match without sitting through the usual pundit noise.
product.primaryAction: Choose an AI Pundit and play a checked show.

aiPundits.promise: Calm, clear, and first with the facts.

today: The player is the first material object on the mobile Today screen.
The screen shows the coverage date, show title, hook, AI Pundit, play or pause control, and real-media progress.
The AI Pundit picker opens as an accessible bottom drawer containing all six choices.
A switch commits only after the requested edition loads. Failure keeps the previous playable edition and offers retry.
Switching while audio plays restarts the selected edition and keeps playing. Switching while paused loads it at the beginning without autoplay.
The current edition can expose up to three proof cards projected from sealed evidence and licensed claim IDs.

If today's edition is unavailable, the API returns the latest published edition for the same AI Pundit with its real coverage date, or failing that the most recent edition any AI Pundit published, and the player names who made it.
Recent published editions appear below the player when they exist.
A quiet How did they do? entry appears only when settled records exist.
avatars: Every AI Pundit has a distinct abstract visual motif.
The visual is generated deterministically from the daily-drop ID and AI Pundit ID, so it changes by edition without changing during one edition.
The current implementation generates SVG geometry in the browser. It does not call an image model at request time.
personalization: All six AI Pundits are free and selectable without an account.
The selected AI Pundit is stored locally and is synced to the profile when the listener is signed in.
A shared pundit or drop query can preview an edition without silently replacing a saved choice.
distribution: The standalone /feed page redirects to Today.
A canonical Reporter RSS endpoint remains available at /api/public/feed.rss.
Legacy archive and episode pages remain available and must stay labelled as archive or demo material.
operations: On 2026-09-04 the founder enabled public launch by recording an explicit override gate snapshot (migration 20260904120000_founder_launch_override.sql). The external human, rights, voice-audition, rehearsal, forecast, and sign-off gates were waived and are listed on that snapshot.

The 04:45 UTC daily workflow runs in publication mode and publishes every AI Pundit edition that passes the automated evidence, harness, transcript, audio, and asset checks enforced by publish_daily_drop(). An edition that falls short is withheld; the ones that passed still publish.

Selected voices are the configured ELEVENLABS_VOICE values, attested by the founder on the voice_candidates row. Proper-name pronunciation is measured against the verified transcript, not a human lexicon.

Since 2026-09-05 each AI Pundit runs as its own workflow step under a per-step model spend ceiling, the drop records its model spend, and a free preflight and a judge calibration harness exist for diagnosis. The judge model was moved to Haiku 4.5 in the production environment on 2026-09-06 as an unverified quality bet recorded in docs/06-ops.md.
New checkout, public forecast scores, prediction registration, evaluation runs, and legacy on-demand narration remain disabled by flags.

Since 2026-09-21 the ingest records one row per run and one row per tracked statistic per day, and reports whether a statistic that arrived yesterday is a withdrawal or a provider rename. Both readings are reported because the fixes are opposite. The two API-Football clients were replaced by one whose failure policy is an argument: the ingest fails soft so a single bad endpoint cannot cost a day of fixtures, prediction registration fails hard because an empty fixture list there would be acted on as no matches to register.

Since 2026-09-21 a script is compared against what this product has already published: its own pundit's portable lines and hooks from the previous fortnight, and the other five editions of the same day. Neither check fails a variant. The recent lines are shown to the writer before it writes, and same-day convergence is reported because it is a fact about the shared claim set rather than about six writers.

currentGaps.truth: Both 2026-09-21 migrations are applied to hzadscrqmyilbisexvyz and read back: ingest_runs, provider_stat_presence and source_match_estimates exist with row level security on and no public policy, standings_snapshots carries captured_on and source with the corrected daily unique constraint, and both versions are recorded. src/integrations/supabase/types.ts is regenerated from the live schema, 45 tables to 48 with none lost, and the CI type canary guards all eight named tables. What has NOT happened is a run: no ingest has executed since the tables appeared, so the league table, the drift ledger and the second expected-goals model are wired and empty rather than proven. The first evidence is the 00:15 UTC ingest. The licence basis for the provider's standings endpoint is still not recorded in release_signoffs, and release_signoffs.gate is a nine-value check constraint with no slot for a data-rights basis, so recording it needs either a gate='legal' row whose notes carry it or a migration widening the enum.
currentGaps.promiseBoundary: Do not claim Full Time reads a league table, carries a second expected-goals model, or detects provider drift until a run has produced rows in those tables and they have been read back. Schema existing is not the same as the pipeline working. No published script can make a season-level or league-position claim until the evidence pack actually carries a table, because the gate refuses one without a cited table fact.

localLimitations: The Windows production build emits the application bundles but the Workflow plugin registers zero steps and zero workflows under both Node 25.5.0 and the required Node 24.19.0. The manifest gate fails as designed. GitHub Actions run 31533126034 passed the production build on Ubuntu and Node 24 for merge 0933a63, so Linux CI or a matching Vercel build is the current build authority.

The skipped test is the exported gate-corpus replay. It skips because src/lib/pundit/__fixtures__/gate-corpus.json does not exist, which is honest rather than green: the suite reports that it has nothing real to replay instead of passing silently.

The gate replay reports fourteen verdicts that passed when written on 4-6 September and are refused by the gates today. None is a regression from this work, which never touches claim-lab.ts or numbers.ts; they are the tightening those weeks were spent on. Eleven are one pre-existing pattern worth fixing: the numeric check reads the components of a date in a claim thesis as unlicensed numbers, so a claim mentioning 31 August 2026 is refused for stating 2026, 08 and 31.

Whether the provider's standings endpoint is inside the paid plan was not verified: no API_FOOTBALL_KEY was available to the session that applied the migrations. No licence basis was recorded on that assumption.

approved: Six AI Pundits can each have a separate thesis, script, humour system, performance plan, and prediction record.
The Today player uses real audio events for progress and completion.
Public proof cards use sealed evidence and licensed claims rather than request-time generated explanations.
Full Time discloses AI-written scripts and synthetic voices.
Full Time does not use copyrighted broadcast audio or imitate a living pundit's recognizable voice or style.
All six AI Pundits are free during the live beta.
Every published show passed automated evidence, harness, transcript, and audio checks.
conditional: Daily reliability requires seven complete rehearsals and revision-bound release approval.
Prediction accuracy or calibration requires a published held-out evaluation and sample context.
Premier League beta exclusivity requires the Teams response and UI restriction to ship.
Personalized ordering requires exact match and team metadata plus multiple approved relevant shows.
prohibited: A human podcast or an imitation of a human pundit
Any claim that human editorial, humour, rights, or voice review has been completed
Guaranteed publication on any given day
Film-level tactical observations without licensed film or tracking evidence
